name: atb-ai-agent
description: Local MVP / Proof of Concept for a secure AI banking assistant for ATB.

scripts.dev:verbose: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "api,ai,web" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:combined: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "api,ai,web" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: cd web-client && npm run dev -- --clearScreen false
